product_overview: An e-commerce web application enabling users to browse products, manage shopping carts, authenticate, customize products, view news and reviews, and manage profiles and orders.
core_goals: Provide secure user authentication with login and registration.
Allow users to browse and search products easily.
Manage shopping cart and checkout processes efficiently.
Enable users to view and manage their profile and order history.
Deliver timely news articles and product reviews to engage users.
key_features: User login and registration system with credential management.
Product listing with detailed information and search functionality.
Shopping cart management including add, update, and remove items.
Checkout process with order confirmation and payment integration.
User profile management including profile update and password change.
Order history listing and detailed order views.
Product customization interface allowing personalized options.
News and reviews sections for latest updates and user feedback.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs into the system via authentication pages.
User browses products, optionally customizing selected products.
User adds products to shopping cart and reviews items in the cart.
User proceeds to checkout, provides payment and shipping details, and confirms order.
User accesses profile page to update personal information.
User views past orders and detailed order information.
Users read news articles and reviews for informed purchase decisions.
validation_criteria: Successful user authentication and session management.
Accurate product listing and real-time shopping cart updates.
Smooth and error-free checkout process with order confirmation.
Ability to update user profile information correctly.
Complete and correct order history and details loading.
Customization options correctly applied and saved.
News and reviews content properly displayed and updated.
